Validate expected family and independence_group mappings

Conservatively cluster MARKET_STRUCTURE, PRICE_ACTION and BREAKOUT
Keep VOLATILITY context-neutral and ineligible for directional confirmation counting
Measure deterministic pairwise Pearson and Spearman dependence without threshold-classifying the numeric result
Fail closed on unknown families, unexpected independence groups and invalid context-family direction
Reconcile P08-H task and lock state across GitHub and Linear

P14 signal fusion and probability calibration
Trade probability, BUY/SELL output, risk approval or execution
